@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_async_persistent_overflow_is_bounded_and_distinct():
    model = _OverflowingModel(max_chars=1)
    middleware = SummarizationMiddleware(model=model, trim_tokens_to_summarize=None)
    with pytest.raises(ContextOverflowError):
        await middleware._acreate_summary(_long_history())
    assert len(model.prompts) == 2
    assert model.prompts[0] != model.prompts[1]


def test_recovery_preserves_original_input_and_trim_configuration():
    model = _OverflowingModel(max_chars=25000)
    middleware = SummarizationMiddleware(model=model, trim_tokens_to_summarize=None)
    messages = _long_history()
    original = [m.model_dump() for m in messages]
    assert middleware._create_summary(messages) == "Summary."
    assert [m.model_dump() for m in messages] == original
    assert middleware.trim_tokens_to_summarize is None


def test_transient_failures_still_retry():
    class TransientModel(_OverflowingModel):
        def _generate(self, messages, stop=None, run_manager=None, **kwargs):
            self.prompts.append(messages[-1].text)
            if len(self.prompts) < 3:
                raise RuntimeError("temporary failure")
            return ChatResult(generations=[ChatGeneration(message=AIMessage(content="Recovered."))])
    model = TransientModel(max_chars=100000)
    middleware = SummarizationMiddleware(model=model)
    middleware._summary_model.wait_exponential_jitter = False
    assert middleware._create_summary([HumanMessage(content="hello")]) == "Recovered."
    assert len(model.prompts) == 3


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_empty_summary_does_not_invoke_model():
    model = _OverflowingModel(max_chars=1)
    middleware = SummarizationMiddleware(model=model)
    assert isinstance(middleware._create_summary([]), str)
    assert isinstance(await middleware._acreate_summary([]), str)
    assert not model.prompts
